title: Yeasty Gooey Kenyan Marzipan Tart
description: A unique date-night dessert featuring Kenyan flavors and a gooey marzipan center, prepared using a bain-marie for a macrobiotic-friendly twist.
instructions: Combine yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in a bowl, add 1/2 cup lukewarm water, and let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a separate bowl, cream together coconut oil and marzipan until smooth.
Add almond flour, egg, and vanilla extract to the marzipan mixture; mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and transfer it to a pie dish, trimming edges to fit, and baking at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Place pie dish in a larger baking dish and fill with water to create a bain-marie; bake for an additional 10 minutes until the crust is golden brown.
Let the tart cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving warm, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
Note: If using a bain-marie, the tart should be baked at 375°F for 25 minutes instead of 10 minutes.
